intro: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected centers on escalating coastal tensions between the Horde and the Alliance following the suspicious destruction of a roadside tavern. The incident delivers a firm warning to Alliance forces while leaving unanswered questions about who truly threatened a vital civilian trade route.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.

However, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.
In any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!
